list.unit: Calle Ramón de Aguinaga 3, apartamento 19, 28028, Madrid
list.txt: A beautiful space; calm & lovely decor. A converted retail unit, obviously works better as a residence, not on a public street & mews gates locked after hours. Retail would not survive well. The space benefits from high ceilings that retail would have, about 4.2m/14'. During retrofit, residential lights were added so remnants of fishing cables in existing walls were visible. The residence above had plumbing that came through the floor above & elbowed within the unit. It had been boxed in with drywall (not yet painted) but maybe not enough acoustic insulation. Didn't bother me but there is an audio of water in pipes regularly. It wasn't too hot during my visit, temp inside was comfortable. I found it strange that no condiments were in the equipped kitchen: maybe salt, pepper, olive oil, tea could be provided? I didn't fly to Spain with a travel sized oil. Only one coffee pod provided. WiFi, workspace, water, bed, laundry were good. Very safe & secure. No access to pool.

list.txt: The apartment worked well for us for our 6-day stay. The shower was a dream, with the strongest pressure and hottest water you can imagine. The beds were comfortable, and since the bedrooms face the internal courtyard of the building, it was nice and quiet for sleeping. The kitchen was functional, though it was only stocked with one dishwasher tab, one extra garbage bag, and a very small bottle of dishsoap. This would be sufficient for a weekend, but I would suggest they double that offering for stays longer than 3 or 4 days. Likewise, it would make a huge difference in the hospitality to have the basics of salt, pepper and olive oil in the pantry. Overall, the apartment could use a bit of a touch-up, and the sofa and rugs could use a deep clean. The location is convenient, as it is near the Ventas Metro, making it quick to get anywhere you want to go pretty easily.

list.txt: A beautiful space; calm & lovely decor. A converted retail unit, obviously works better as a residence, not on a public street & mews gates locked after hours. Retail would not survive well. The space benefits from high ceilings that retail would have, about 4.2m/14'. During retrofit, residential lights were added so remnants of fishing cables in existing walls were visible. The residence above had plumbing that came through the floor above & elbowed within the unit. It had been boxed in with drywall (not yet painted) but maybe not enough acoustic insulation. Didn't bother me but there is an audio of water in pipes regularly. It wasn't too hot during my visit, temp inside was comfortable. I found it strange that no condiments were in the equipped kitchen: maybe salt, pepper, olive oil, tea could be provided? I didn't fly to Spain with a travel sized oil. Only one coffee pod provided. WiFi, workspace, water, bed, laundry were good. Very safe & secure. No access to pool.

Pedro and his team were amazing, attentive, and always helpful. We had absolutely no complaints and would wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone visiting Madrid. We’d love to stay here again!
The location was great close to transit, reaturants and shopping. Easy access to the train station and metro.

Una tomadura de pelo - En piso está limpio y bien situado. Alquilamos un piso de tres habitaciones y dos baños, y solo tenía dos habitaciones y un baño. Primero miramos la reserva para tres personas, con dos habitaciones, y nos sale trescientos y pico euros. Cuando decidimos ir cuatro personas, añadimos una habitación y un baño y nos sube el precio a cuatrocientos y pico (lógico) y sin embargo el piso es de dos habitantes y un solo baño. Además, la ficha no funcionaba correctamente. El termostato está roto y el agua sale hirviendo. Estuvimos llamando todo el puente (4 días) y no nos dieron ninguna solución. Me parece una estafa.

list.unit: Calle del Barco 42, 2º Interior Izquierda, 28004, Madrid
list.txt: This place was an excellent place to stay in every way. Great location, close to the centre but far enough to not be right in with enormous crowds. Apartment was superbly equipped compared to others I have stayed in whilst in the city. Oven, stove, toaster, coffee machine. More than enough cleaning materials, hoover, mop, clothing horse, iron, ironing board, hairdryer, washing machine and dishwasher both with complimentary tablets. Bedroom was cosy and had windows for sunlight, living room area also had windows for sun, a large TV and couch which made for a cosy vibe. Bathroom was a good size with great lighting. Apartment was easy to find, from the airport was only two short train rides and a five minute walk. Plenty of supermarkets, restaurants and corner shops minutes away. One small thing I would like to note, the apartment is on the second floor and the stairs up would be a little wonky for older people. This apartment is perfect in every way, for both short and long term stays.

list.unit: Calle Don Ramon de la Cruz 54, 3A, 28001, Madrid
list.txt: This is the second time we have stayed in this apartment, and we were very happy. The apartment was perfect for the four of us, with ample light and a small but fully equipped kitchen. The full-size fridge was really appreciated. The apartment is very quiet (it is in the back of the building) and has beautiful afternoon sun. The location couldn't have been better. The service was incredible; they even moved a plant because of my allergies. No complaints. We will be back.

list.unit: Plaza de America Española 1, Bajo, Apartamento 4, 28028, Madrid
list.txt: The apartment worked well for us for our 6-day stay. The shower was a dream, with the strongest pressure and hottest water you can imagine. The beds were comfortable, and since the bedrooms face the internal courtyard of the building, it was nice and quiet for sleeping. The kitchen was functional, though it was only stocked with one dishwasher tab, one extra garbage bag, and a very small bottle of dishsoap. This would be sufficient for a weekend, but I would suggest they double that offering for stays longer than 3 or 4 days. Likewise, it would make a huge difference in the hospitality to have the basics of salt, pepper and olive oil in the pantry. Overall, the apartment could use a bit of a touch-up, and the sofa and rugs could use a deep clean. The location is convenient, as it is near the Ventas Metro, making it quick to get anywhere you want to go pretty easily.

list.unit: Calle Ramón de Aguinaga 3, apartamento 19, 28028, Madrid
list.txt: A beautiful space; calm & lovely decor. A converted retail unit, obviously works better as a residence, not on a public street & mews gates locked after hours. Retail would not survive well. The space benefits from high ceilings that retail would have, about 4.2m/14'. During retrofit, residential lights were added so remnants of fishing cables in existing walls were visible. The residence above had plumbing that came through the floor above & elbowed within the unit. It had been boxed in with drywall (not yet painted) but maybe not enough acoustic insulation. Didn't bother me but there is an audio of water in pipes regularly. It wasn't too hot during my visit, temp inside was comfortable. I found it strange that no condiments were in the equipped kitchen: maybe salt, pepper, olive oil, tea could be provided? I didn't fly to Spain with a travel sized oil. Only one coffee pod provided. WiFi, workspace, water, bed, laundry were good. Very safe & secure. No access to pool.

Ótimo para amigos, casais e solteiros, não recomendo para quem tem crianças. - A localização é muito boa, em um local cheio de barzinhos e restaurantes. Fizemos tudo a pé e de metro. Foi fácil pegar a chave com as instruções do anfitrião. O apartamento é bem equipado, tem geladeira, fogão, ferro de passar, aquecedor, utensílios de cozinhas e etc. O apartamento estava limpo e organizado. Tem aquecedores por todos os lados e exaustores. Achamos que tínhamos duas camas, nos confundimos nas fotos, mas no andar superior é um sofá que vira cama, a internet não é muito rápida, a privada é no andar de cima, então tem que ficar descendo e subindo, as cortinas não cobrem totalmente as janelas então entra muita claridade a noite dos postes da rua e de dia do sol, a máquina de lavar lava mas não seca (tem um varal de chão no apartamento), e as escadas não tem tela de proteção e acabam sendo um pouco perigosas para quem tem filhos. list.txt: This place was an excellent place to stay in every way. Great location, close to the centre but far enough to not be right in with enormous crowds. Apartment was superbly equipped compared to others I have stayed in whilst in the city. Oven, stove, toaster, coffee machine. More than enough cleaning materials, hoover, mop, clothing horse, iron, ironing board, hairdryer, washing machine and dishwasher both with complimentary tablets. Bedroom was cosy and had windows for sunlight, living room area also had windows for sun, a large TV and couch which made for a cosy vibe. Bathroom was a good size with great lighting. Apartment was easy to find, from the airport was only two short train rides and a five minute walk. Plenty of supermarkets, restaurants and corner shops minutes away. One small thing I would like to note, the apartment is on the second floor and the stairs up would be a little wonky for older people. This apartment is perfect in every way, for both short and long term stays.

list.unit: Calle Ramón de Aguinaga 3, apartamento 19, 28028, Madrid
list.txt: A beautiful space; calm & lovely decor. A converted retail unit, obviously works better as a residence, not on a public street & mews gates locked after hours. Retail would not survive well. The space benefits from high ceilings that retail would have, about 4.2m/14'. During retrofit, residential lights were added so remnants of fishing cables in existing walls were visible. The residence above had plumbing that came through the floor above & elbowed within the unit. It had been boxed in with drywall (not yet painted) but maybe not enough acoustic insulation. Didn't bother me but there is an audio of water in pipes regularly. It wasn't too hot during my visit, temp inside was comfortable. I found it strange that no condiments were in the equipped kitchen: maybe salt, pepper, olive oil, tea could be provided? I didn't fly to Spain with a travel sized oil. Only one coffee pod provided. WiFi, workspace, water, bed, laundry were good. Very safe & secure. No access to pool.

Quiet location, new building with a lift. Spacious clean modern apartment with two bathrooms. Single bed was very small in the 2nd bedroom. More for a child than an adult. The AC unit in the lounge was not working but we were out all day so it wasn’t really an issue. It took about 30 mins to walk to the high street and cathedral area. Around an hours walk to Plaza De Espana but shops and restraints along the way. Well worth going there. There were plenty of bars and restaurants close by the apartment if you didn’t want to venture out in the evening. We found a lovely restaurant for lunch, a pizza place and a Resturant for brunch/breakfast only 5 mins walk away We had a very pleasant stay and felt safe. Our only issue was not having anywhere to store our luggage on the day we checked out. Our flight home was in the evening. There are a few locker places 15 min walk away but there was some confusion with the link the host sent us and it didn’t work out for us.

한국인분들께 꿀팁 드립니다. 1. 숙소위치는 메트로파라솔 기준으로 도보 10분 정도에 위치해있어서 접근성이 좋습니다 2. 숙소치안: 숙소 나오면 바로 큰길이라 치안은 걱정없고 1층이라 위험하지 않을까 싶겠지만 별일 없었습니다 3. 소음, 청결: 소음은 없었는데 간혹 옆방 물내리는 소리 정도는 들립니다. 청결도는 매우 좋으나, 화장실 하루살이 정도는 좀 있는 것 같습니다. 모기 없음! 4. 주방, 침실: 주방 깔끔, 침실 푹신! 욕조가 있어서 좋긴한데 사용할 일은 없을 것 같아요. 침대는 깨끗하고 빈대 없어요. 주방도 인덕션 잘되고 환기 잘됩니다. 5. 에어컨, 세탁기, 냉장고: 냉동칸 엄청 잘돌아가서 매일 아아 타먹기 좋습니다. 에어컨 엄청 추워요! 온도 조절 잘하세요. 세탁기도 깔끔하고 빨래하면 금방 잘 마릅니다.

list.unit: Calle del Barco 42, 2º Interior Izquierda, 28004, Madrid
list.txt: This place was an excellent place to stay in every way. Great location, close to the centre but far enough to not be right in with enormous crowds. Apartment was superbly equipped compared to others I have stayed in whilst in the city. Oven, stove, toaster, coffee machine. More than enough cleaning materials, hoover, mop, clothing horse, iron, ironing board, hairdryer, washing machine and dishwasher both with complimentary tablets. Bedroom was cosy and had windows for sunlight, living room area also had windows for sun, a large TV and couch which made for a cosy vibe. Bathroom was a good size with great lighting. Apartment was easy to find, from the airport was only two short train rides and a five minute walk. Plenty of supermarkets, restaurants and corner shops minutes away. One small thing I would like to note, the apartment is on the second floor and the stairs up would be a little wonky for older people. This apartment is perfect in every way, for both short and long term stays.

list.unit: Calle del Barco 42, 2º Interior Izquierda, 28004, Madrid
list.txt: This place was an excellent place to stay in every way. Great location, close to the centre but far enough to not be right in with enormous crowds. Apartment was superbly equipped compared to others I have stayed in whilst in the city. Oven, stove, toaster, coffee machine. More than enough cleaning materials, hoover, mop, clothing horse, iron, ironing board, hairdryer, washing machine and dishwasher both with complimentary tablets. Bedroom was cosy and had windows for sunlight, living room area also had windows for sun, a large TV and couch which made for a cosy vibe. Bathroom was a good size with great lighting. Apartment was easy to find, from the airport was only two short train rides and a five minute walk. Plenty of supermarkets, restaurants and corner shops minutes away. One small thing I would like to note, the apartment is on the second floor and the stairs up would be a little wonky for older people. This apartment is perfect in every way, for both short and long term stays.

Our only issue was not having anywhere to store our luggage on the day we checked out. Our flight home was in the evening. There are a few locker places 15 min walk away but there was some confusion with the link the host sent us and it didn’t work out for us.

한국인분들께 꿀팁 드립니다. 1. 숙소위치는 메트로파라솔 기준으로 도보 10분 정도에 위치해있어서 접근성이 좋습니다 2. 숙소치안: 숙소 나오면 바로 큰길이라 치안은 걱정없고 1층이라 위험하지 않을까 싶겠지만 별일 없었습니다 3. 소음, 청결: 소음은 없었는데 간혹 옆방 물내리는 소리 정도는 들립니다. 청결도는 매우 좋으나, 화장실 하루살이 정도는 좀 있는 것 같습니다. 모기 없음! 4. 주방, 침실: 주방 깔끔, 침실 푹신! 욕조가 있어서 좋긴한데 사용할 일은 없을 것 같아요. 침대는 깨끗하고 빈대 없어요. 주방도 인덕션 잘되고 환기 잘됩니다. 5. 에어컨, 세탁기, 냉장고: 냉동칸 엄청 잘돌아가서 매일 아아 타먹기 좋습니다. 에어컨 엄청 추워요! 온도 조절 잘하세요. 세탁기도 깔끔하고 빨래하면 금방 잘 마릅니다.

- Nice, modern apartment that matches the photos, with a spacious, private patio and high-tech building. However, the service and communication were very poor, with conflicting messages and no clear organization. The cleaner entered without notice on day1 and arrived 3hours late on day2 despite our agreed schedule. The shower drain gives off an awful smell reaching the bed, which wasn't fixed despite being told so. There are no shower curtains, so the bathroom floods every time and staff just suggested using extra towels, which made a soggy mess on the ground each time we took a shower + ants were everywhere. The worst part was that the jacuzzi (main reason why we booked this apartment) took literally over 5 hours to heat (not "a few minutes" as claimed). Lastly, the space lacks soundproofing and light blocking, making sleep difficult. Cosy and well-furnished, but the service is definitely not worth the price. You can get far better service elsewhere for half the cost.

한국인분들께 꿀팁 드립니다. 1. 숙소위치는 메트로파라솔 기준으로 도보 10분 정도에 위치해있어서 접근성이 좋습니다 2. 숙소치안: 숙소 나오면 바로 큰길이라 치안은 걱정없고 1층이라 위험하지 않을까 싶겠지만 별일 없었습니다 3. 소음, 청결: 소음은 없었는데 간혹 옆방 물내리는 소리 정도는 들립니다. 청결도는 매우 좋으나, 화장실 하루살이 정도는 좀 있는 것 같습니다. 모기 없음! 4. 주방, 침실: 주방 깔끔, 침실 푹신! 욕조가 있어서 좋긴한데 사용할 일은 없을 것 같아요. 침대는 깨끗하고 빈대 없어요. 주방도 인덕션 잘되고 환기 잘됩니다. 5. 에어컨, 세탁기, 냉장고: 냉동칸 엄청 잘돌아가서 매일 아아 타먹기 좋습니다. 에어컨 엄청 추워요! 온도 조절 잘하세요. 세탁기도 깔끔하고 빨래하면 금방 잘 마릅니다.

- Nombreux problèmes de propreté et d'entretien constatés lors de notre arrivée: - sols et surfaces des meubles poussièreux - cheveux et poils dans les douches et sur la literie - plaque de la cuisine et vaisselle sale, graisse sur rebord des placards - traces de calcaires dans les douches - literie qui sent mauvais avec traces de moisi sur un oreiller dans le placard - une douche et un lavabo bouchés, odeur d'égoût dans la 2e douche - impossible d'éteindre la lumière de l'escalier, néon de la SdB en panne - dose de lessive au lieu de pastille lave-vaisselle - tuyau de l'aspirateur complétement bouché, les employés de ménage travaillaient avec, nous avons dû le déboucher devant eux. La plupart des problèmes ont été résolus (sauf l'odeur de la douche qui persiste) après entretien avec le directeur et envois de photos à l'agence. Cela a toutefois pris deux jours (moitié de notre séjour), deux ménages et deux techniciens. Beaucoup de stress, d'énergie perdue et vacances en partie gâchées.

Apartamento moderno, limpio y muy bien ubicado, a pocos minutos de Gran Vía, ideal para una escapada de compras o para visitar la ciudad. La comunicación fue excelente durante toda la estancia, con respuestas rápidas y ayuda inmediata cuando la necesitamos. Como único punto a tener en cuenta, la segunda habitación no tenía una cama doble como esperábamos, sino una cama individual con otra cama extra deslizante debajo. Además, esta zona no estaba completamente separada, ya que solo contaba con una cortina en lugar de una pared o puerta. Fuera de eso, todo fue perfecto y disfrutamos mucho de la estancia.

list.unit: Calle de Gran Via 45, 8 planta, puerta 6 28013 Madrid
list.txt: We had a lovely stay at this stylish apartment in the heart of Madrid, right on Gran Vía! The location is fantastic, with everything you need just a few steps away. The apartment is on the top floor and the views are absolutely amazing. It is also incredibly convenient for getting around, with both Plaza de España and Santo Domingo metro stations just a 2–3 minute walk away. There are plenty of restaurants, shops and amenities right downstairs, including a souvenir shop next to the building entrance and a Carrefour supermarket directly across the street. The apartment is also very walkable, making it an excellent base for exploring Madrid. Having both a washing machine and dryer in the apartment was another great bonus. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay. The apartment is stylish, comfortable, and exceptionally well located, with incredible views and everything within easy reach. We would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to stay in a central location in Madrid!

The location is what stands out about this rental. The apartment was actually bigger than we expected and suited our family perfectly. It was fairly clean, nothing particularly unsettling except the bathtub which has some non-slip pads that should be replaced. While we did run into some issues with the washing machine, Minty Stay was extremely responsive and helpful. We were a little surprised at how bare the apartment was — no spices in the kitchen, a single dish rag, a travel sized amount of dish soap, no cleaning products or broom to pick up after ourselves if needed — for a 4-night stay with two children this was not ideal. Perhaps it is best suited for people who are spending most meals outside the home. Still, we had a very pleasant stay and would recommend.

list.unit: Calle del Barco 40, 1º Interior, Puerta 4, 28004, Madrid
list.txt: Nos encantó la ubicación del departamento, ya que está muy cerca de los principales puntos de interés y cuenta con supermercados, cafeterías y restaurantes a pocos pasos. El barrio nos pareció seguro y agradable. El alojamiento estaba limpio y tenía todo lo necesario para nuestra estancia. Como único inconveniente, consideramos que el espacio es bastante reducido para tres personas. Por ello, lo recomendamos especialmente para una o dos personas, que podrán disfrutarlo con mayor comodidad. En general, tuvimos una buena experiencia y destacamos principalmente la excelente ubicación.

list.unit: Calle Ramón de Aguinaga 3, apartamento 19, 28028, Madrid
list.txt: A beautiful space; calm & lovely decor. A converted retail unit, obviously works better as a residence, not on a public street & mews gates locked after hours. Retail would not survive well. The space benefits from high ceilings that retail would have, about 4.2m/14'. During retrofit, residential lights were added so remnants of fishing cables in existing walls were visible. The residence above had plumbing that came through the floor above & elbowed within the unit. It had been boxed in with drywall (not yet painted) but maybe not enough acoustic insulation. Didn't bother me but there is an audio of water in pipes regularly. It wasn't too hot during my visit, temp inside was comfortable. I found it strange that no condiments were in the equipped kitchen: maybe salt, pepper, olive oil, tea could be provided? I didn't fly to Spain with a travel sized oil. Only one coffee pod provided. WiFi, workspace, water, bed, laundry were good. Very safe & secure. No access to pool.

L'appartamento di Javier è in posizione strategica rispetto al centro centrissimo e ai musei come Reina Sofia - veramente dietro l'angolo - e al museo El Prado. Il quartiere di Lavapìes è diviso in due aree, risulta tranquillo di fatto, ma molto più frequentato e sicuro nella parte alta vicino alla metro Anton Martin dove è anche pieno di locali, rispetto alla metro Lavapìes. L'appartamento era molto pulito, e la comunicazione con Javier sempre veloce ed efficiente, ma l'appartamento in foto sembra più spazioso che nella realtà, e il fatto che sia praticamente senza finestre, eccetto una che affaccia sul pianerottolo del palazzo, lo rende buio e bisognoso tutto il giorno di luce artificiale, poco confortevole se ci alloggi anche per lavoro. Il costo probabilmente è parametrato all'esuberante mercato di Madrid, ma sicuramente è alto rispetto all'offerta.

- Äiti & kaksi teiniä, viisi yötä Pariisissa. Asunto oli pääosin kuten kuvauksessa. Tuoleja olikin enemmän, parisänky vähän kapeampi. Kylpyhuoneessa saapuessa homeen haju, joka ei meitä sen enempää haitannut. Raput ovat erittäin kapeat ja hissi on hyvin pieni mutta toimiva. Kolme ikkunaa avautuvat kaikki sisäpihalle, näkymä vastakkaisiin seiniin, kuitenkin hyvin luonnonvaloa. Sijainti oli meille erinomainen. Alueella runsaasti erilaisia ravintoloita ja kauppoja. Metrolle muutamia kymmeniä metrejä, lisäksi useita bussireittejä lähellä. Neljälle aikuiselle useammaksi yöksi asunto olisi liian ahdas mutta meille kolmelle aivan riittävä kun kävimme siellä lähinnä nukkumassa. Naulakoita / koukkuja seiniin olisin kaivannut mm. takeille kun asunnossa ei ole eteistä. Voisin majoittua uudelleen!

L'appartamento di Javier è in posizione strategica rispetto al centro centrissimo e ai musei come Reina Sofia - veramente dietro l'angolo - e al museo El Prado. Il quartiere di Lavapìes è diviso in due aree, risulta tranquillo di fatto, ma molto più frequentato e sicuro nella parte alta vicino alla metro Anton Martin dove è anche pieno di locali, rispetto alla metro Lavapìes. L'appartamento era molto pulito, e la comunicazione con Javier sempre veloce ed efficiente, ma l'appartamento in foto sembra più spazioso che nella realtà, e il fatto che sia praticamente senza finestre, eccetto una che affaccia sul pianerottolo del palazzo, lo rende buio e bisognoso tutto il giorno di luce artificiale, poco confortevole se ci alloggi anche per lavoro. Il costo probabilmente è parametrato all'esuberante mercato di Madrid, ma sicuramente è alto rispetto all'offerta.

list.unit: Calle de Bocangel 34, apto Bajo A, 28028, Madrid
list.txt: The apartment itself was beautiful: stylish, comfortable, and well kept. We had an issue with the door lock one night, and while it took some time to sort out, the host followed up and made things right in the end, which we appreciated. One thing future guests should know: although it's listed under Salamanca, the apartment is a 20–30 minute walk from the heart of the neighborhood, with not much nearby. For the price, we expected a more central location. If you don't mind the walk or plan to get around by taxi, it's a lovely place to stay.

list.unit: Plaza de America Española 1, Bajo, Apartamento 4, 28028, Madrid
list.txt: The apartment worked well for us for our 6-day stay. The shower was a dream, with the strongest pressure and hottest water you can imagine. The beds were comfortable, and since the bedrooms face the internal courtyard of the building, it was nice and quiet for sleeping. The kitchen was functional, though it was only stocked with one dishwasher tab, one extra garbage bag, and a very small bottle of dishsoap. This would be sufficient for a weekend, but I would suggest they double that offering for stays longer than 3 or 4 days. Likewise, it would make a huge difference in the hospitality to have the basics of salt, pepper and olive oil in the pantry. Overall, the apartment could use a bit of a touch-up, and the sofa and rugs could use a deep clean. The location is convenient, as it is near the Ventas Metro, making it quick to get anywhere you want to go pretty easily.

Quiet location, new building with a lift. Spacious clean modern apartment with two bathrooms. Single bed was very small in the 2nd bedroom. More for a child than an adult. The AC unit in the lounge was not working but we were out all day so it wasn’t really an issue. It took about 30 mins to walk to the high street and cathedral area. Around an hours walk to Plaza De Espana but shops and restraints along the way. Well worth going there. There were plenty of bars and restaurants close by the apartment if you didn’t want to venture out in the evening. We found a lovely restaurant for lunch, a pizza place and a Resturant for brunch/breakfast only 5 mins walk away We had a very pleasant stay and felt safe. Our only issue was not having anywhere to store our luggage on the day we checked out. Our flight home was in the evening. There are a few locker places 15 min walk away but there was some confusion with the link the host sent us and it didn’t work out for us.
